title: The Ink on the Thank-You Note
youtube_title: The Ink on the Thank-You Note | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Sable wants to check on a thank-you note whose ink was still wet before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Sable leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
